note: Single source of truth for every configuration constant. Scripts MUST read from here. No implicit defaults are permitted anywhere in scripts/.

photon_budgets.note: These two are distinct quantities and must never share a name or a variable. n_transport_photons controls the Monte Carlo accuracy of the R and J estimates. n_measurement_photons is the hypothetical experimental budget entering the Fisher likelihood.

n_transport_photons.meaning: Monte Carlo numerical precision of the R, J estimates

n_measurement_photons.meaning: assumed experimental photon budget in the Fisher likelihood

psi_description: upper-plexus blood volume fraction, physical BVF
deep-plexus blood volume fraction, physical BVF
parameters.phi_description: P1 legacy coordinates: elementwise log of [f_U*S_U, f_U*(1-S_U), f_D*S_D, f_D*(1-S_D), DermR, SubQ]

spectral_normalization.note: Dimensionless normalization applied before eigendecomposition or SVD. StO2 coordinates carry scale 1 because they are already dimensionless and O(1); the rest are scaled by their nominal value.

blood_coordinate.legacy_reference: blood variable referenced to 28 g/L hemoglobin rather than whole blood
blood_coordinate.invariance: eps and f enter mu_a only as a product, so dividing both blood coordinates by the divisor while multiplying both eps vectors by it leaves every layer absorption and reflectance unchanged.

production.purpose: the single configuration the merged manuscript reports

min_count_rule.note: disabled in the main analysis; all 30 bins retained. MIN_COUNT=5 is run only as a sensitivity profile.

p1_legacy.purpose: reproduce the original P1 raw-Jacobian SVD exactly
p1_legacy.note: This profile forms no Fisher matrix, assumes no noise model and computes no CRB, by design of the original script.

p2_legacy.purpose: reproduce the original P2 diagonal-Poisson FIM exactly
p2_legacy.source: jax-pad-fisher/scripts/fisher/fim_boundary_poisson_pooled.py (headline bounds); build_fim_stack.py (Fk); fim_analyze.py (a separate min-count path)

min_count_rule.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-30. P2's published bounds (sdU 0.084033, sdD 1.912834 at N_tot=4e5) come from fim_boundary_poisson_pooled.py, whose only condition is r<=R_MAX and R>0. MIN_COUNT=5 appears in fim_analyze.py, which is NOT the headline path: enabling it drops 54 of 120 bins and moves the deep bound to 2.4225, a 26.6% change. Reproduction confirms the no-filter route matches the frozen values to 1e-11.

p2_legacy.parameter_order_note: Gcw is stored in production order; fim_stack.npz applies PERM=[0,2,1,3,4,5]. Any consumer must state which it uses.
